The station stores each soil moisture reading with a UTC timestamp and hashes the calibration table before issuing a watering command.

The fictional operation manual states: "The controller closes the irrigation valve whenever the soil sensor remains above the wet threshold for three consecutive samples." (Source A, section 2).

The controller never opens the valve when moisture is above seventy percent; it waits for three dry readings.

A camera estimates greenhouse leaf area from purple calibration cards and uploads images at dawn.
